{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"

test_orders = data[data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = data_filtered['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Get the shape of the filtered dataframe
filtered_shape = data_filtered.shape

total_revenue, filtered_shape"}
